note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1958: nominations 20 May 1958; six contests, polled 5 June 1958. The outgoing member in Moyra Castle was deemed re-elected. Labels as printed in the Newry Telegraph nominations list. Polled 5 June 1958. The outgoing member was John Reid, J.P. (U.). Peter Feighan was also nominated (Newry Reporter, 22 May 1958) but is not in the result. The Armagh Guardian (13 June 1958, p. 7) prints the same figures.
